description: The figure is a two-level donut (nested pie) chart labeled in the center as “Win rate (%)”, showing the distribution of win rates between two models across two rings. There are 2 slices in the outer ring: a large light-blue slice labeled “LLaMA: 80.4%” and a smaller dark-blue slice labeled “GPT-4o: 19.6%”. There are also 2 slices in the inner ring: a large very light beige slice (unlabeled in the ring itself) and a smaller dark red slice labeled “GPT-4o: 12.0%”. The chart uses callout labels with leader lines rather than percentage text inside the slices, includes no legend, and no slices appear exploded or offset; the slices are arranged around the circle with the largest segments occupying most of each ring.
